raw.details:
Overview

TRIVORA 2026 is a national-level 24-hour hackathon presented by HackHere, bringing together students, developers, designers, researchers and technology innovators to build intelligent, scalable solutions using Generative AI and Cloud Computing.

Event Details

  • Dates: 5th & 6th December 2026
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Theme: Generative AI × Cloud
  • Mode: Offline
  • Registration Fee : Rs 1000 per team
  • Team Size: 1–4 Members
  • Registration: Slot-based

Key Highlights

  • Cash prizes and exciting rewards
  • Internship and career opportunities
  • Exclusive AI and cloud credits
  • Unique problem statement for every team
  • Real-world technology challenges
  • Industry mentorship and networking
  • Certificates, recognition and partner benefits
  • Opportunity to build and deploy a working product

Hackathon Theme: Generative AI × Cloud

Teams must develop innovative, intelligent and scalable solutions by combining the capabilities of Generative AI with modern cloud technologies.

The solutions should demonstrate practical applications of AI, efficient cloud deployment, scalability, responsible data usage and measurable real-world impact.

Unique Problem Statement Allocation

  • Every participating team will receive a unique problem statement.
  • All problem statements will follow the common theme of Generative AI × Cloud.
  • Problem statements will be revealed at the beginning of the hackathon.
  • Once allocated, teams cannot exchange or change their problem statement.
  • Each team must independently design, develop and present its solution.
  • Solutions must be developed during the official hackathon period.

Why Participate?

  • Build a working solution within 24 hours
  • Solve a unique real-world problem
  • Explore Generative AI and cloud technologies
  • Gain hands-on product development experience
  • Learn from industry mentors and professionals
  • Access internship and career opportunities
  • Receive exclusive technology credits and benefits
  • Network with innovators from different institutions
  • Showcase your skills on a national platform

Eligibility & Team Rules

  • Open to UG and PG students
  • Students from all academic disciplines may participate
  • Team Size: 1–4 members
  • Inter-college teams are allowed
  • Inter-department teams are allowed
  • Multidisciplinary teams are encouraged
  • Each participant may be part of only one team

Hackathon Process

Phase 1 – Problem Allocation & Ideation

  • Each team will receive a unique problem statement.
  • Teams must analyse the challenge and plan their proposed solution.
  • Mentors may guide teams during idea validation.
  • Teams must work only on their assigned problem statement.

Phase 2 – Prototype Development

  • Teams will develop their solution during the 24-hour hackathon.
  • The solution should meaningfully use Generative AI and cloud technologies.
  • Mentors and industry professionals will interact with participants.
  • Teams may undergo progress evaluations during development.

Phase 3 – Final Submission & Evaluation

  • Teams must submit their final prototype and presentation.
  • Shortlisted teams will demonstrate their solutions before the jury.
  • Evaluation will focus on technical quality, innovation, scalability and practical impact.

Submission Requirements

Teams must submit:

  • Working prototype or MVP
  • Presentation deck
  • Source-code repository
  • Solution description
  • Technology stack
  • Cloud architecture or deployment details
  • Demo or deployment link, wherever applicable
  • Expected impact and scalability

Evaluation Criteria

  • Innovation and originality
  • Effective use of Generative AI
  • Cloud implementation and scalability
  • Technical quality
  • Functionality
  • Relevance to the assigned problem
  • Practical impact and feasibility
  • Security and responsible data use
  • Final presentation and demonstration
